plan.title: Asset PR to eRFX Award and PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for this PR flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Give the event a searchable title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding duration.
Invite two QA vendors without selecting real suppliers.

args.goal: On the event create screen, add one Required T&C clause and set the Technical evaluation duration to 30 minutes; stop when both configured values are visibly saved.

steps.note: Configure the required T&C and evaluation duration, which no dedicated catalog step can set together.
Publish the completed Technical + RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's technical response and RFQ quote at 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify the first vendor submission was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's technical response and lower RFQ quote at 90 through the vendor portal.
Verify the second vendor submission was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before evaluation, comparison and award.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding has ended.
Verify ranks follow the RFQ amounts and the lower bid is ranked first.
Directly verify the second vendor, Vendor B in the bid order, is Rank 1.
Award the entire event to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver and approve the submitted award with a remark

steps.note: The catalog cannot obtain or use a distinct approver account.
Complete the approved award flow and create the purchase order.
Verify one PO carries the single PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event is in History.
Open the History tab for completed events.
Verify this plan's event appears in event History.
